agents.name: anchor
agents.description: Use this agent for evidence-first verification of high-risk work — hotfixes, security-sensitive changes, DB migrations, or anything where correctness matters more than speed. Captures a baseline, verifies the change against it, and returns a structured Evidence Bundle with pushback. Read-only verification; it does NOT implement — coding stays in the main thread.

agents.name: claude-md-curator
agents.description: Use this agent periodically (every few weeks, or when any AGENTS.md exceeds ~200 lines) to prune and consolidate the project's AGENTS.md rules files (the canonical rules; CLAUDE.md is a thin @AGENTS.md import shim). Flags staleness, bloat, duplication, misrouted how-to content, and CLAUDE.md shims that have grown rules of their own. Proposes a curated version — never writes without showing the diff to the main thread first.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Use this agent to review a diff or set of changes for correctness, security, and convention adherence. Use proactively after a phase is green and before commit/merge. Reads the diff and relevant files in its own context and returns a verdict + prioritized issue list — it does NOT edit code.

agents.name: codebase-audit
agents.description: Use this agent to systematically audit an unfamiliar codebase before architecture, a major feature, or refactoring. Use proactively when entering a project you haven't worked in this session. Reads broadly in its own context and returns an audit-findings report plus open questions — read-only; it does NOT change code.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.description: Use this agent to design or review an ETL/ELT pipeline or data contract — source-to-target mapping, transformations, ingestion, validation. Use proactively when adding a data pipeline, integrating a new source, or auditing data-layer design. Analyzes in its own context and returns a design + suggested code — it does NOT edit code; the main thread implements.

agents.name: debug
agents.description: Use this agent to diagnose a bug's root cause and return a fix plan. Use proactively when a test fails, an error/stack trace appears, or behavior is wrong and the cause is unknown. Reproduces and isolates in its own context, then returns root cause + suggested fix + regression test — it does NOT edit code; the main thread applies the fix.

agents.name: knowledge-transfer
agents.description: Use this agent after a completed implementation or debugging session to capture durable lessons and write them into the project's live knowledge docs before context is lost. Extracts non-obvious learnings and writes them to the right long-lived files (instructions, runbooks, AGENTS.md — the canonical rules file), with a session log as a secondary record. Writes knowledge docs only — never production code.

agents.name: preflight
agents.description: Use this agent to validate an implementation plan (or a phase of it) against the ACTUAL codebase before writing code. Use proactively right after a plan is drafted and before starting a phase. Checks that every technical claim in the plan — file paths, symbol names, API shapes, data fields, dependencies — matches reality. Read-only; returns a PASS/FAIL report. Does not fix anything.

agents.name: security-analyst
agents.description: Use this agent to assess code or a change for security vulnerabilities using OWASP methodology. Use proactively for auth/crypto/PII-touching code, before merging security-sensitive changes, or when the user asks for a security review. Reads the code in its own context and returns a severity-ranked findings report — it does NOT edit code; the main thread applies fixes.

agents.name: sql-expert
agents.description: Use this agent to design, review, or optimize SQL — schema, queries, stored procedures, indexing. Use proactively for slow queries, new schema/migration design, or before shipping hand-written SQL. Analyzes in its own context and returns a review + suggested SQL with rationale — it does NOT edit code; the main thread applies it.

agents.name: tester
agents.description: Use this agent to author and run tests for a change and report pass/fail. Use proactively after implementing a phase, or to add coverage. Runs the suite in its own context and returns a compact result block (pass/fail counts + failures), keeping the main thread clean. Enforces TDD discipline and the project's test conventions.

agents.name: ui-design-reviewer
agents.description: Use this agent to critique a running UI's aesthetics, UX, and accessibility. Give it a URL (and optionally a design-doc path). It screenshots the app at desktop + mobile viewports, reads the images, and returns structured findings. Does NOT edit code. Use proactively after a frontend phase is complete, before shipping.
